channel.title: The Daily Record - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Daily Record (thedailyrecord.com)

item.title: Her partner was killed in a MD assisted-living facility. She’s now suing.
item.description: An assisted-living facility worker accused of fatally shooting an 87-year-old resident had been the subject of repeated concerns by colleagues that the Maryland facility ignored, a lawsuit claims.

item.title: Transource could build power line next year through part of MD
item.description: An energy company is again taking steps to build a 29-mile-long transmission line through the Cumberland Valley, partly in Western Maryland.

item.title: MTA reform bill slashes state liability for bus and train crashes
item.description: Maryland's MTA Reform Act caps liability for bus and train crash claims at $400,000, aligning MTA with other state agencies.

item.title: Crossover Day: Budget, juvenile justice, sex designations prioritized
item.description: The Maryland House and Senate shuffled through dozens of bills Monday, the General Assembly’s Crossover Day deadline.

item.title: Judges appoint new acting US attorney in New Jersey
item.description: Robert Frazer was appointed acting U.S. attorney in New Jersey by federal judges, ending a year-long leadership dispute.

item.title: 4th Circuit revives suit over gluten-free meals at community in MD
item.description: The 4th Circuit reinstated a woman's breach of contract and negligence claims against a retirement community over gluten-free meal issues.

item.title: Supreme Court: Police officer is immune from misconduct claim
item.description: The Supreme Court shielded a police officer from a claim that he used excessive force on a protester during a sit-in at Vermont’s capitol.

item.title: Trump administration pushes to deport Kilmar Abrego Garcia to Liberia
item.description: The Trump administration is again trying to send the wrongly deported Kilmar Abrego Garcia to Liberia and urging a federal judge to dismiss a bar on his removal.

item.title: Supreme Court weighs Trump's power to limit asylum processing
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court is set to hear a defense by the Trump administration of the government's authority to turn away asylum seekers.

item.title: BTS ARMY, with $5.3B in spending power, coming to Baltimore
item.description: Analysts say the BTS tour could generate a windfall of $5.32 billion across the 44 cities — including Baltimore — that will host the Kpop supergroup.
